attributes.board_name: South Dakota Board of Physical Therapy

rules.accepted_credit_types: Activities directly related to PT practice and approved by APTA, APTA South Dakota, the SD Board of Physical Therapy, or another state's PT/PTA licensing board (ARSD 20:66:03:02 as of Oct 3, 2024). Category 1 (certified coursework) up to all 30 hours; Category 2 (participatory activities) max 15 hours per renewal. Online unlimited. CEUs on certificates convert x10 to hours (1 clock hour = 1 CE hour = 0.1 CEU). Course approval requests via CEU Locker.
rules.new_licensee_rule: New graduates of an accredited DPT/PTA program within the 2-year cycle may request a waiver of up to 15 CE hours for the first renewal; CE courses taken before graduation but within the cycle count.
rules.audit_note: Licensee checks a box on the renewal application confirming the hours and attaches the SDBPT continuing education summary form; proof of completion only if randomly audited.
rules.notes: Biennial license periods run January 1 to January 1 (e.g. 01.01.25-01.01.27). 30 hours per two-year period since January 1, 2024 (previously 15 hours per year). Waivers for illness, disability, military service or financial hardship: affidavit at least 30 days before the period ends. No mandatory topics.
